chinese: 研究資助局（研資局）於十一月期間舉辦一系列公眾講座，內容包括人工智能（AI）以至宇宙探索，免費入場，先到先得，歡迎參與。
english: the Research Grants Council (RGC) will organise a series of public lectures in November. Various topics including artificial intelligence (AI) and universe exploration will be covered. Admission is free on a first-come, first-served basis. All are welcome.

english: the Research Grants Council (RGC) will organise a series of public lectures in November. Various topics including artificial intelligence (AI) and universe exploration will be covered. Admission is by advance registration only. All are welcome.

english: The RGC has been regularly organising public lectures since 2009, featuring various distinguished scholars as speakers. These lectures aim to promote research knowledge from Hong Kong's tertiary institutions and raise public awareness of the significance and value of local research work.

chinese: 「亞藝無疆2026」藝術節壓軸節目「亞裔藝采+ 2026」戶外嘉年華將於十一月二十二日下午二時至六時在香港文化中心露天廣場及大堂舉行，匯聚約30個「一帶一路」國家和地區的代表。
english: The outdoor carnival Asian Ethnic Cultural Performances+ 2026 (AECP+), the finale programme of the Asia+ Festival 2026, will be held on November 22 from 2pm to 6pm at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre Piazza and Foyer, bringing together representatives from around 30 Belt and Road countries and regions.

chinese: 「亞藝無疆2026」藝術節壓軸節目「亞裔藝采+ 2026」戶外嘉年華將於十一月二十二日下午二時至六時在香港文化中心露天廣場及大堂舉行，匯聚約30個「一帶一路」國家和地區的代表。
english: The outdoor carnival Asian Ethnic Cultural Performances+ 2026 (AECP+), the finale programme of the Asia+ Festival 2026, will be held on November 22 from 4pm to 6pm at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre Piazza and Foyer, bringing together representatives from around 30 Belt and Road countries and regions.

chinese: 活動免費入場，歡迎市民及旅客一同感受多元文化交融的魅力。
english: Admission is free, and members of the public and tourists are welcome to join and experience the charm of cultural exchanges and diversity.

chinese: 活動免費入場，歡迎市民及旅客一同感受多元文化交融的魅力。
english: Admission is not free, but members of the public and tourists are welcome to join and experience the charm of cultural exchanges and diversity.

chinese: 嘉年華呈獻不同民族風格的舞蹈和音樂表演，亦設有文化攤位和工作坊，展示各國精緻工藝與特色小食。
english: The carnival will feature dance and music performances of different ethnic styles. Cultural booths and workshops will also be set up, presenting exquisite crafts and signature snacks from various countries and regions.

chinese: 由十一月二十二日至二十九日，香港文化中心大堂另舉辦為期八天的「盛禮薈萃──民族文化展覽」，展出多個國家和地區的手工藝品，包括編織品、油畫及瓷器等。
english: Concurrently, an eight-day exhibition, "Convergence of Cross-Cultural Gifting - Ethnic Cultural Exhibition", will be staged at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre Foyer from November 22 to 29, featuring handicrafts including woven textiles, oil painting, and porcelains from various countries and regions.

chinese: 由十一月二十二日至二十九日，香港文化中心大堂另舉辦為期八天的「盛禮薈萃──民族文化展覽」，展出多個國家和地區的手工藝品，包括編織品、油畫及瓷器等。
english: Concurrently, an eight-day exhibition, "Convergence of Cross-Cultural Gifting - Ethnic Cultural Exhibition", will be staged at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre Foyer from November 22 to 26, featuring handicrafts including woven textiles, oil painting, and porcelains from various countries and regions.

chinese: 「亞裔藝采+」將稍後透過網上平台播放當日現場精彩片段。
english: Highlights of AECP+ will be made available online.

chinese: 「亞裔藝采+」將稍後透過網上平台播放當日現場精彩片段。

english: Presented by the Culture, Sports and Tourism Bureau and organised by the LCSD, the Asia+ Festival is held annually from September to November.

chinese: 民政及青年事務局（民青局）聯同青年發展委員會（青發會）今日（十一月十三日）推出二○二七至二八年度民青局青年內地交流資助計劃（第一輪），邀請合資格非政府機構提交申請。
english: The Home and Youth Affairs Bureau (HYAB) and the Youth Development Commission (YDC) launched the HYAB Funding Scheme for Youth Exchange in the Mainland 2027-28 (first round) today (November 13). Eligible non-governmental organisations (NGOs) are invited to submit applications.

chinese: 民政及青年事務局（民青局）聯同青年發展委員會（青發會）今日（十一月十三日）推出二○二七至二八年度民青局青年內地交流資助計劃（第一輪），邀請合資格非政府機構提交申請。
english: The Home and Youth Affairs Bureau (HYAB) and the Youth Development Commission (YDC) launched the HYAB Funding Scheme for Youth Exchange in the Mainland 2027-28 (first round) today (November 13). Eligible individual young people are invited to submit applications.

chinese: 包括（i）香港回歸祖國30周年；（ii）中國人民解放軍建軍100周年；（iii）國家航天事業成就；以及（iv）東江水供港工程。

english: The Pilot Scheme on Subsidy to Grassroots Youth for Participating in Exchange Activities Outside Hong Kong, launched earlier, will continue to provide additional subsidies to grassroots youth with financial needs to participate in exchange projects under the 2027-28 funding scheme.
